0.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON050TRADE_00221_JALZAHN_000_000
0.description: You are ready to recreate a legendary arm from times of eld? Then let us make the soul of your current relic ascend to a new-forged vessel, and so remake a...a Zodiac Weapon!

1.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON050TRADE_00221_JALZAHN_000_001
1.description: Yes, the Zodiac Weapon we make with these will be finer than aught else in the land. If you are firm in your purpose, let us begin!

2.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON050TRADE_00221_MENU_TITLE
2.description: What Zodiac Weapon would you like to recreate?

8.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON050TRADE_00221_JALZAHN_000_030
8.description: Where is your relic? We cannot transform it into materia if it is not in your possession.

9.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON050TRADE_00221_SYSTEM_000_031
9.description: Please ensure that the relic you wish to transform into materia for your Zodiac Weapon is placed in your Armoury Chest or inventory before speaking with Jalzahn.

10.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON050TRADE_00221_JALZAHN_000_040
10.description: You do not seem to possess a soulglazed relic weapon, my friend.

11.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON050TRADE_00221_JALZAHN_000_050
11.description: You do not have what we need to recreate a Zodiac Weapon. Pray return here after you have acquired the requisite items.

12.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON050TRADE_00221_SYSTEM_000_051
12.description: In order to recreate a Zodiac Weapon, you must possess a copy of the Book of Skylight, a pinch of zodium, a Zodiac scroll, and a piece of flawless alexandrite.

13.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON050TRADE_00221_JALZAHN_000_060
13.description: ...Did I not but recently remake the very same arm? Surely there is no need for you to possess two!

15.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON050TRADE_00221_JALZAHN_100_070
15.description: I cannot well perform my work until you make room among your mess of possessions.

16.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON050TRADE_00221_JALZAHN_000_100
16.description: The culmination of our efforts is so close at hand, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>!

17.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON050TRADE_00221_JALZAHN_000_101
17.description: Come, let us call Master Mutamix, and then...to work!

18.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON050TRADE_00221_GEROLT_000_102
18.description: So I'm to be first. Well, jus' ye watch what I can do with this ol' hammer an' anvil! I'll forge a host fer the Zodiac Weapon what's got no equal in all Eorzea!

19.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON050TRADE_00221_GEROLT_000_103
19.description: Whew... Well, 'tis done. Behold the weapon precisely as it was in days o' yore! All that's left is to meld materia to it.

20.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON050TRADE_00221_JALZAHN_000_104
20.description: Well, Master Mutamix, I believe that is your area of expertise─will you transform <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>'s relic into materia?

21.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON050TRADE_00221_MUTAMIX_000_105
21.description: Pshhh... Shkohhh...<hex:02100103>...This relic is very mighty fighty-tool, full of airyself. Mutamix has many shivershakes!

22.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON050TRADE_00221_MUTAMIX_000_106
22.description: Cannot give wordbond the secret joiny-skill of Mutamix will be success! If fail, fighty-tool will turn to bittybits!

23.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON050TRADE_00221_SYSTEM_000_107
23.description: Please be warned the chance of success for turning a relic weapon nexus into materia is 1.4%. Your relic will be lost if the process fails.

27.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON050TRADE_00221_Q2_000_000
27.description: Please be warned the chance of success for turning a relic weapon nexus into materia is 1.4%. Your relic will be lost if the process fails. Are you certain you wish to proceed?

30.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON050TRADE_00221_Q3_000_000
30.description: Abandon your attempt to recreate a Zodiac Weapon?

33.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON050TRADE_00221_GEROLT_000_110
33.description: That's the spirit! Well, ye heard the bold <hex:02080EE905FF056C617373FF046C616403>, Mutamix─make the relic into materia!

34.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON050TRADE_00221_GEROLT_000_111
34.description: Bah! Yer really goin' to slink off after all ye done to get this far? Where's yer gods-given sense of adventure!? Never mind what <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503> says, Mutamix. Ye go ahead an' do yer thing!

35.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON050TRADE_00221_GEROLT_000_112
35.description: Oi, where's yer godsdamned spine, <hex:02080EE905FF056C617373FF046C616403>!? Don't ye want yer toy no more!? Bah, the hells with ye─do yer thing, Mutamix!

36.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON050TRADE_00221_MUTAMIX_000_113
36.description: Then let the chance-game of many heartthumps begin!

37.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON050TRADE_00221_MUTAMIX_000_114
37.description: Gianteyes! Does Mutamix truesee!? The relic fighty-tool of the uplander is now materia! Mutamix has success muchly!

38.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON050TRADE_00221_GEROLT_000_115
38.description: Hah! I knew ye had it in ye, Mutamix!

39.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON050TRADE_00221_JALZAHN_000_116
39.description: Then all that remains for us is to join the relic-made materia to Gerolt's Zodiac Weapon host.

40.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON050TRADE_00221_JALZAHN_000_150
40.description: Come, let us call Master Mutamix, and set about recreating the weapon!

41.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON050TRADE_00221_JALZAHN_000_200
41.description: Now, I shall attempt to complete the arm with the Zodiac scroll and flawless alexandrite!

42.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON050TRADE_00221_JALZAHN_000_201
42.description: Ages past, a wise and just king reigned over all Ilsabard. A blade such as this graced his scabbard in times of peace, and brought terror to his foes in times of strife!

43.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON050TRADE_00221_JALZAHN_000_202
43.description: And his shield? A twin to the one you hold, unwavering, unyielding, unbreaking.

44.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON050TRADE_00221_JALZAHN_000_203
44.description: When cataclysm loomed over the Near East, the hero Mirza arose to defend the people from fell fiends. Once he had torn the monsters apart, he raised a mighty empire─and fashioned a pair of weapons such as these from his foes' claws!

45.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON050TRADE_00221_JALZAHN_000_204
45.description: An ancient hero seized a weapon like this from a voidsent lord. At the time it was taken, legend tells us it was a sword. Yet later, it transformed to match the bent of its wielder and became a mighty battleaxe!

46.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON050TRADE_00221_JALZAHN_000_205
46.description: It was holy blood that gave divine might to the original polearm of Longinus. However, it was only once the hero set forth upon a great pilgrimage to atone for his part in the execution of a saint that the gods lent him their strength.

47.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON050TRADE_00221_JALZAHN_000_206
47.description: Behold, the likeness of the longbow once drawn by Yoichi, the famed archer of the Far East! Ancient legend says that the hero could loose a shaft so true as to pierce the eye of a sea serpent, even amidst a raging tempest!

48.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON050TRADE_00221_JALZAHN_000_207
48.description: After long years spent spurning worldly desires, a Near Eastern hierarch rose to a higher state of being. And as he did, life itself quickened within his trusty staff, the very twin of which you now hold!

49.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON050TRADE_00221_JALZAHN_000_208
49.description: Tales tell of an archmagus who struck down the voidsent queen Lilith when she manifested in our realm. As his prize, he claimed her weapon─the incarnation of which you now grasp in your hand!

50.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON050TRADE_00221_JALZAHN_000_209
50.description: Who penned the original of this grimoire in times of eld is a mystery. Yet it is said that the predictions of world's end it holds are so dark as to destroy weak men's wills!

51.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON050TRADE_00221_JALZAHN_000_210
51.description: Legend tells us a grimoire such as this was passed down through the mages of Nym. Indeed, Golbas Rombas, the hero who saved his people from the floods of the Sixth Umbral Calamity, was known to rely upon it as his secret weapon.

52.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON050TRADE_00221_JALZAHN_000_211
52.description: Sasuke, the hero who freed a people from a tyrant's reign, wielded blades like these. The ninja himself bore the blood of ancient heroes, and his own descendants bore the daggers for long generations after he passed away.

53.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON050TRADE_00221_JALZAHN_000_212
53.description: Come, take up your <hex:02310CFF054974656D04E802020203>─born of stars' radiance, forged through heroes' might, and imbued with souls' blessing!
